name: Chest
description: The chest helps move your upper arm forward and across your body. Explore horizontal and incline pressing movements.
cue: Keep the movement controlled and your shoulders comfortable.

name: Shoulders
description: The front, side, and rear deltoids help raise and position your arms. Different movement directions emphasize different portions.
cue: Avoid shrugging or arching your back to finish a repetition.

name: Biceps
description: The biceps help bend your elbow and turn your palm upward. Curl variations change your grip and arm position.
cue: Keep your upper arms steady instead of swinging the weight.

name: Triceps
description: The triceps extend the elbow and assist pressing movements. Explore cable, dumbbell, and bodyweight options.
cue: Move through a comfortable range without snapping the elbows.

name: Forearms
description: Forearm muscles help control the wrist, fingers, and grip. Carries and controlled wrist movements provide different challenges.
cue: Start light and keep the wrists in a comfortable position.

name: Abdominals
description: The abdominal muscles contribute to trunk movement and stability. Explore controlled movement and stability exercises.
cue: Keep breathing rather than holding your breath for the whole set.

name: Obliques
description: The obliques help rotate and support the trunk. Anti-rotation and side-support exercises challenge them in different ways.
cue: Keep your torso steady and choose a range you can control.

name: Quadriceps
description: The quadriceps help straighten your knees. Squats, split squats, and supported machine movements offer different training options.
cue: Keep your feet grounded and knees moving comfortably with your toes.

name: Calves
description: The calf muscles help point the foot downward. Straight-knee and bent-knee variations challenge the region differently.
cue: Use a controlled rise and descent without bouncing.

name: Upper back
description: These muscles help position and move your shoulder blades. Rows and pulling variations work this area alongside the arms.
cue: Let your shoulder blades move naturally without jerking the torso.

name: Lats
movement: Pull the upper arm down & back
description: The lats help move your upper arm toward your body. Explore vertical pulls and row variations.
cue: Lead with your elbows and avoid using momentum.

name: Lower back
description: The muscles alongside your spine contribute to posture and trunk control. Start with supported, controlled stability work.
cue: Keep the movement comfortable; do not force spinal extension.

name: Glutes
description: Your glutes help extend and stabilize your hips. Bridges, hinges, and split-stance movements provide different options.
cue: Move through the hips without overextending your lower back.

name: Hamstrings
movement: Bend the knee & extend the hip
description: The hamstrings help bend your knees and extend your hips. Explore both curling and hip-hinge movements.
cue: Move slowly and stop the range before you lose control.
